title: Difficult Food
description: This is a mod that contains more types of potatoes.
body:
This proyect is a potato-related mod, with four types of potatoes: bad-cutted potato, good potato, excellent potato, and The Potato.
It also have 4 types of knifes, with the same tier as the potatoes.
If you like potatoes I'm sure this mod likes you.

It also contains potato blocks to improve knives. As there are many recipes, it goes very well with the JEI (Just Enough Items) mod.
